name: CompanyWise
description: Technical interview preparation platform indexing 3,411 LeetCode problems across 490+ tech companies with frequency metrics, recency tiers, and 18 DSA curriculum tracks.

capabilities.name: Company LeetCode Questions
capabilities.description: Filter and search interview questions asked by 490+ companies over multiple time windows (30 days, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year, 2+ years, all-time).

capabilities.name: 18 DSA Pattern Curriculums
capabilities.description: Comprehensive algorithmic pattern guides with templates, interactive visualizations, and curated practice problems.

capabilities.name: Client-side Progress Tracking
capabilities.description: Privacy-first local storage progress tracking with optional public LeetCode profile synchronization.
